run_generate_asm_lcov: run the script with a callgrind folder and build folder to generate LCOV coverage output for assembly files
merge_callgrind_annotate: merge callgrind output files with assembly source files using callgrind_annotate and return combined annotated data
parse_callgrind_data: parse annotated callgrind execution flow data for a source file and update per-line execution counts
generate_execution_counts: generate execution counts for all annotated assembly files from merged callgrind_annotate output sections
output_lcov_format: output a dictionary of filenames and execution counts as LCOV coverage format with SF and DA lines
